entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'To Shut the Bear's Mouth'
identity: Wild animals are one of the greatest threats to you now.  By entreating the aid of the spirits who rule over dangerous creatures and using the droppings of living animals, you can prevent nearby wild animals from attacking you.
entries.singular: Wild animals are one of the greatest threats to you now.  By entreating the aid of the spirits who rule over dangerous creatures and using the droppings of living animals, you can prevent nearby wild animals from attacking you.
